title: A button with depth
description: A raised button presses down from the point you touch, then returns with a spring.
useCase: Give an occasional action a tactile response without moving its hit area.
interaction: Press near different edges of the button
reducedMotion: The button stays stationary and uses color to show its pressed state.
limitations: The example toggles a local saved state. Avoid adding this motion to high-frequency controls.
look: Pale sage page with one wide off-white rounded button raised on a darker olive base, with a dark grey sans-serif label.
motion: Pressing sinks the button face 5 px and tilts it up to 7° toward the touch point with a stiff spring, tinting it pale green; release springs it back.
adapt: `usePressDepth` tracks press state and the normalised `origin`; the face is a `motion.span` animating `y`, `rotateX`, `rotateY` and `backgroundColor` with the `PRESS` spring (`stiffness: 520`, `damping: 34`). Replace the label and `saved` toggle; tune the 7° tilt and 5 px travel.
